kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-skill-group --instance-id ccc-test --skill-group-id skillgroup@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: Skill group ID, in the format: skill group name\@instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 技能组ID，格式为：技能组名称@实例ID
